description: Generate a video clip from a prompt, or animate a still by passing image_url. Runs Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0 and the rest of the SayMaker shelf on your own credits; many of them return sound in the same pass. Needs an API key. On a free account, pass model minimax-h3-fast (480p or 768p, 4 to 15 seconds).

duration.description: Clip length in seconds where the model offers a choice, e.g. 4, 6, 8, 10 (MiniMax H3 Fast also 15).

image_url.description: Optional first frame — makes this image-to-video.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to Seedance 2.0.

prompt.description: The shot: what happens, where, how the camera moves.

sound.description: Ask for sound where the model writes it in the same pass (default true).

wait.description: Wait for the result (default false — video takes minutes).

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video
